onThisDay.title: UN General Assembly resolution on Suez Crisis
onThisDay.description: The UN General Assembly adopted a resolution calling on the United Kingdom, France and Israel to immediately withdraw their troops from Egypt during the Suez Crisis.
onThisDay.upscLink: World history: Suez Crisis, decolonisation and UN peacekeeping; India's non-aligned role.

onThisDay.title: War Powers Resolution passed over Nixon veto
onThisDay.description: The U.S. Congress overrode President Richard Nixon's veto to pass the War Powers Resolution, which limits presidential power to wage war without congressional approval.
onThisDay.upscLink: Polity: separation of powers and checks on executive war powers.

onThisDay.title: Bangladesh uprising frees Ziaur Rahman
onThisDay.description: In Bangladesh, an uprising led by Colonel Abu Taher ousted and killed Brigadier Khaled Mosharraf, freeing the house-arrested army chief and future president Ziaur Rahman.
onThisDay.upscLink: India-Bangladesh relations: post-1975 Bangladesh political turmoil and rise of Ziaur Rahman.

onThisDay.title: Willi Stoph resigns in East Germany
onThisDay.description: East German Prime Minister Willi Stoph and his entire cabinet were forced to resign after huge anti-government protests.
onThisDay.upscLink: Cold War: fall of Berlin Wall and German reunification.

onThisDay.title: NASA launches Mars Global Surveyor
onThisDay.description: NASA launched the Mars Global Surveyor, a robotic spacecraft that mapped Mars and studied its surface, atmosphere and magnetic field.
onThisDay.upscLink: Science & Tech: Mars exploration and space missions.
